title: Jim anderton to appear on youth suicide programme
content:
18 October 2000

Jim anderton to appear on youth suicide programme

  • Jim Anderton
Deputy Prime Minister

Jim Anderton MP is to appear at the end of the TV3 television drama, Questions tonight and talk about Youth Suicide.

The show features dramas exploring the issues and is followed by discussion. Jim Anderton will appear for five minutes at the very end of the show that finishes at 10.30.
